prompt:
I'm getting some TypeScript errors in my modal component and I'm not sure if my type definitions are correct. The component takes in an isOpen boolean, an onClose function, and a title string. I defined the props interface like this: interface ModalProps { isOpen: boolean; onClose: () => void; title: string; }. Does this look right or should I add more strict typing?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must recommend using Box instead of div or span elements for the modal container.
The answer must recommend using SpaceBetween for spacing between elements in the modal.
The answer must not suggest using the any type in production code.
The answer must confirm that the isOpen, onClose, and title prop types in the interface are correctly defined.
The answer must provide a clear assessment of the interface before suggesting additional strict typing improvements.
